en: The postcard shows a colored image of a lovely, tree-shaded avenue with manicured green lawns and a prominent fountain in a park-like setting. Grand buildings with red-tiled roofs line the background, and an old-fashioned streetlamp stands near the path. The photo has a nostalgic, early 20th-century style. At the bottom of the image, it is labeled 'BAD PYRMONT, HAUPTALLEE.' The back of the card is marked 'Postkarte' with German-language text and an old 'DEUTSCHES REICH' postage stamp, and a blue stamp from the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
